title: server/schema: notification preference columns, NotificationMute model, new notification types
description:
Branch: feature/notification-preferences off main, in a dedicated worktree (00-core-invariants). Layer-isolated: schema + migration only.

(a) Extend UserNotificationSettings (model at schema.prisma:689). Keep the four existing columns and their meaning (pushEnabled = master push switch; friendRequestsEnabled / messagesEnabled / gameRemindersEnabled = PUSH flag of their category) so old app builds keep working. Add per-category channel flags, all Boolean:
  friendRequestsInApp @default(true)
  gameRemindersInApp @default(true)
  myGamesPush @default(true), myGamesInApp @default(true)
  invitationsPush @default(true), invitationsInApp @default(true)
  organizerPush @default(true), organizerInApp @default(true)
  groupGamesPush @default(true), groupGamesInApp @default(true)
  friendGamesPush @default(true), friendGamesInApp @default(true)
  friendJoinsPush @default(false), friendJoinsInApp @default(false)   (opt-in, high fan-out)
  cityGamesPush @default(<DECISION D1>), cityGamesInApp @default(true)
  cityGamesDigest Boolean @default(false)   (true = no instant city push, one daily summary instead)
  cityGamesSports SportType[] @default([])   (empty = all sports)
  cityGamesCities String[] @default([])      (empty = the user's profile city; stored normalized via shared cityAliases)
  quietHoursEnabled Boolean @default(false), quietHoursStart Int @default(1380), quietHoursEnd Int @default(420)   (minutes since local midnight; window may wrap midnight)
  timezone String @default("Asia/Jerusalem")
  snoozeUntil DateTime?   (pause all push until this instant)
  digestHour Int @default(8), lastDigestAt DateTime?   (digest worker claim sentinel)
  updatedAt DateTime @default(now()) @updatedAt

(b) New model NotificationMute { id cuid, userId, targetType NotificationMuteTarget (enum USER | SERIES | GAME), targetId String, until DateTime? (null = forever), createdAt; user relation onDelete Cascade; @@unique([userId, targetType, targetId]); @@index([targetType, targetId]) }. Add the back-relation on User.

(c) Add NotificationType values: FRIEND_NEW_GAME, FRIEND_JOINED_GAME, NEW_SERIES_GAME (series/group currently misuses NEW_GAME_IN_CITY at gameService.js:879 and :1320).

Migration SQL hand-written to match (ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE, ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN with defaults, CREATE TABLE + indexes). Existing rows get defaults -> no behavior change except D1. Run `npx prisma migrate dev` against a local/branch DB only and `npx prisma generate`; never against prod (prisma-db.mdc).

title: server: pure preference engine (category map, defaults, validation, delivery decision)
description:
New pure module, no Prisma access, fully unit-tested.

Exports:
- CATEGORY_BY_TYPE: FRIEND_REQUEST, FRIEND_ACCEPTED -> 'friendRequests'; NEW_MESSAGE -> 'messages' (push only, no in-app channel); GAME_REMINDER -> 'gameReminders'; GAME_CANCELLED, GAME_UPDATED, GAME_JOIN_APPROVED, GAME_JOIN_REJECTED, GAME_WAITLIST_OFFER, GAME_REMOVED_PEER, GAME_ROLE_UPDATE -> 'myGames'; GAME_INVITATION -> 'invitations'; GAME_JOIN_REQUEST -> 'organizer'; NEW_SERIES_GAME -> 'groupGames'; FRIEND_NEW_GAME -> 'friendGames'; FRIEND_JOINED_GAME -> 'friendJoins'; NEW_GAME_IN_CITY -> 'cityGames'. Unknown type -> deliver on both channels (fail open, log).
- CHANNEL_FIELDS: category -> { push: column, inApp: column|null } (friendRequests.push = friendRequestsEnabled, messages.push = messagesEnabled, gameReminders.push = gameRemindersEnabled, the rest the new columns).
- DEFAULT_SETTINGS (mirrors schema defaults) and withDefaults(row|null).
- sanitizeSettingsUpdate(body): whitelist known keys, coerce/validate types (booleans; minutes 0..1439; digestHour 0..23; IANA timezone validated via Intl.DateTimeFormat; cityGamesSports subset of SportType; cityGamesCities trimmed, de-duplicated, normalized with shared cityAliases, max 10; snoozeUntil ISO or null, capped at now+30d). Returns { data, errors }; unknown keys ignored, invalid values -> errors (route returns 400).
- isInQuietHours(settings, now): local minutes in settings.timezone via Intl; handles wrap-around (start > end) and start === end (= disabled).
- isMuted(mutes, ctx, now): ctx = { actorId, seriesId, gameId }; a mute matches by targetType/targetId and (until null or until > now).
- decideDelivery({ settings, mutes, type, ctx, now }) -> { inApp: bool, push: bool, reason }. Rules: category channel flags; push additionally requires pushEnabled, not snoozed, not in quiet hours; cityGames push also false when cityGamesDigest; muted actor/series/game -> both false EXCEPT safety-critical types that are never muted (GAME_CANCELLED, GAME_WAITLIST_OFFER, GAME_JOIN_APPROVED/REJECTED, GAME_REMOVED_PEER): those always keep in-app and only obey channel flags + quiet hours for push.
- toClientSettings(row, mutes): settings DTO + legacy fields unchanged so old clients still parse it.

Tests: every category mapping, legacy columns honored, quiet-hours wrap and DST boundary in Asia/Jerusalem, snooze expiry, mute expiry, safety-critical bypass, digest suppressing city push, sanitize rejects bad input. No DB needed: run `cd server && npx jest tests/notificationPrefs.test.js`.

title: server: enforce preferences in NotificationService (single choke point) + batch fan-out
description:
Today prefs are only checked inside sendPushToAllDevices (notificationService.js:118-147) and the DB row + socket event are always created (sendNotification :75-111).

- Add private loadPrefs(userIds[], ctx): one findMany on userNotificationSettings + one on notificationMute (filter userId in ids AND targetId in [ctx.actorId, ctx.seriesId, ctx.gameId]), returns Map<userId, {settings: withDefaults(row), mutes}>. Drop the legacy try/catch 'table doesn't exist' fallback — the table exists in every env.
- sendNotification(userId, type, title, body, data, io): call decideDelivery with ctx taken from data ({ actorId: data.actorId, seriesId: data.seriesId, gameId: data.gameId }). If !inApp skip DB row + socket emit; if !push skip push; return the row or null. Signature unchanged so all existing callers keep working.
- sendPushOnly: same gate (messages category), push only.
- sendPushToAllDevices: remove its own settings checks (moved into the gate) and accept the already-decided call; keep device fan-out / stale-token cleanup as is.
- New sendNotificationToMany(userIds, type, title, body, dataOrFn, io): de-dupe ids, load prefs in one batch, then per-user decide + create rows with createMany-free individual creates (need ids for socket payload) — chunk 50 at a time with Promise.allSettled so a 2k-user city fan-out doesn't open 2k parallel queries against the Neon pooler.
- getSettings(userId): upsert-on-read (replace the current findUnique+create race at :402-414 with upsert) and return toClientSettings(row, activeMutes) including the mutes list joined with display info (user name/avatar, series name, game title) for the settings screen.
- updateSettings(userId, data): data already sanitized by the route.
- addMute/removeMute/listMutes helpers.

Tests (jest, mocked prisma object passed to constructor — no DB): in-app off -> no row, no socket; push off -> row but no push; muted actor suppresses FRIEND_NEW_GAME but not GAME_CANCELLED; quiet hours -> row yes, push no; sendNotificationToMany issues exactly one settings query for N users.

title: server: settings + mutes API (validated) on /api/notifications
description:
- PUT /settings (routes/notifications.js:162-180): replace the 4-field destructure with sanitizeSettingsUpdate(req.body); 400 { error, details } on invalid; partial updates supported (current code writes `undefined` for omitted fields, which Prisma ignores — keep partial semantics explicit). Response = toClientSettings.
- GET /settings: returns full DTO incl. mutes.
- GET /mutes, POST /mutes { targetType, targetId, until? | durationHours? } (validate targetType enum; verify target exists; cannot mute yourself; upsert on the unique key), DELETE /mutes/:targetType/:targetId. All authenticateToken, userId from req.user only (server-invariants: never trust a body userId).
- POST /settings/snooze { hours: 1|2|4|8|24 | null } convenience endpoint -> sets/clears snoozeUntil.
- Remove the unauthenticated GET /test route (dead, leaks route existence) only if nothing references it (grep next_app/mobile_app first).

Extend the existing integration test file (it already covers GET/PUT): new fields persist; invalid timezone / minutes -> 400; legacy body { pushEnabled:false } still works; mute CRUD round trip; muting self -> 400. Run: `cd server && PORT=3099 npx jest tests/notificationSettings.test.js --runInBand --detectOpenHandles --forceExit`.

title: server: rework game-created fan-out (city filters, friends-only leak, friend games, group games)
description:
Current block gameService.js:982-1004 notifies EVERY user whose profile city matches, with no opt-out, and also for friends-only games (privacy bug — buildVisibilityWhere at :323 hides those from non-friends, but the push/in-app copy still announces them). Friends get no notification at all (only a socket 'game:created' at :965-979).

New flow after the create transaction (still fire-and-forget, never blocks the response):
1. friendIds = creator's friendships (reuse the query already done at :966).
2. FRIEND_NEW_GAME to friendIds via sendNotificationToMany, data { gameId, actorId: creatorUser.id, link: `/game/${id}`, sport }.
3. If !game.isFriendsOnly (or friendsOnlyUntil already passed): city recipients = users where id not in (creator, ...friendIds) AND either (settings.cityGamesCities is empty AND user.city matches game city via cityAliases, case-insensitive) OR cityGamesCities has normalized game city; AND (cityGamesSports empty OR has game.sport). Users without a settings row count as defaults. Implement as a prisma query with relation filters (notificationSettings: { is: null } OR { ... }) — no in-memory scan of all users. Send NEW_GAME_IN_CITY via sendNotificationToMany with actorId + gameId (so per-user mutes apply).
4. If the game is friends-only with a friendsOnlyUntil in the future, do NOT city-notify now (out of scope to schedule a later city blast — note it in the PR).
5. Series/group paths (:879 and :1320): switch type to NEW_SERIES_GAME, add seriesId + actorId to data, use sendNotificationToMany; fix the inconsistent link `/games/` -> `/game/` used by the other notifications (check next_app/src/utils/notificationRoute.ts and mobile notificationDisplay to confirm which one resolves).

Tests (DB-backed, unique ids, clean up after): friend gets FRIEND_NEW_GAME and not the city one; friends-only game -> no city notification to strangers; sport filter excludes; extra city opts in a user from another city; cityGamesInApp=false -> no row; muted organizer -> nothing.

title: server: friend-joined-game notification + actorId on all actor-originated notifications
description:
- Add notifyFriendsOfJoin(game, joiningUser, io): on a CONFIRMED join (the paths that call notifyOrganizerOfInstantJoin, gameService.js:400), send FRIEND_JOINED_GAME to the joiner's friends via sendNotificationToMany, excluding organizer and anyone already a participant of that game; skip friends-only games for friends who can't see it (they can — they're friends of the joiner, not necessarily the organizer: apply buildVisibilityWhere semantics, i.e. only notify friends who are also friends of the organizer when game.isFriendsOnly). Default for this category is off, so cost only applies to opted-in users.
- Add actorId to data everywhere an actor exists so per-user mutes work: notifyOrganizerOfInstantJoin/PendingRequest/WaitlistJoin (actorId = joining user), notifyUserAddedToGame (actorId = adderId), cancelGame (actorId = canceller, still never muted per step 2), gameRoster.js:361/:658 removal notices (actorId = manager), and add gameId everywhere (already present). No copy changes.
- Run only the touched tests plus any existing test that imports these functions (grep server/tests for notifyOrganizerOf / notifyUserAddedToGame).

title: server: daily digest worker for city games
description:
- Cron every 15 min (node-cron, same style as workers/cleanupWorker.js). For users with cityGamesDigest=true AND cityGamesPush=true AND pushEnabled=true whose local time (settings.timezone) hour == digestHour and lastDigestAt older than 20h: claim with updateMany({ where: { userId, OR:[{lastDigestAt:null},{lastDigestAt:{lt: cutoff}}] }, data: { lastDigestAt: now } }) — count 0 means another instance took it (server-invariants: background-job idempotency).
- Count visible open games created since previous lastDigestAt (or 24h) matching the user's city/sport filters and not organized by a muted user or by friends (they got FRIEND_NEW_GAME); if >0 send one push-only summary (type NEW_GAME_IN_CITY, data { digest: true, link: '/games?city=...' }), bilingual copy via titleEn/bodyEn like addedToGameNotification. Quiet hours/snooze still apply via the gate.
- Register in index.js next to startCleanupWorker (index.js:1214) behind the same RUN_BACKGROUND_JOBS guard that the scheduler uses.
- Test: claim is idempotent across two concurrent runs; zero matching games -> no push; wrong hour -> skipped.

title: shared: NotificationSettings / mute types and category metadata for both clients
description: Single source for both clients (see shared-types.mdc): NotificationSettings interface matching toClientSettings, NotificationMute { targetType, targetId, until, label, imageUrl }, NOTIFICATION_CATEGORIES ordered list [{ key, pushField, inAppField|null, group: 'social'|'myGames'|'discovery' }], QUIET_HOURS helpers (minutesToHHMM / HHMMToMinutes), SNOOZE_OPTIONS [1,2,4,8,24]. No UI strings (each client localizes). Re-export from index.js and index.d.ts (index.d.ts is a 4th file only for the re-export line — allowed as part of this atomic shared step; if the 3-file rule is enforced strictly, split the index.d.ts line into step 9). Add a small node:test for the time helpers like the other shared/*.test.js.

title: web: notifications API client methods
description: Add getSettings, updateSettings(partial), snooze(hours|null), getMutes, mute({targetType,targetId,until?}), unmute(targetType,targetId) to next_app's notificationsApi (pattern: existing apiClient + token). Types from shared. Add the shared index.d.ts re-export line if not done in step 8.

title: web: rebuild /settings/notifications (fix broken auth, auto-save, full controls)
description:
Bug: page.tsx:53 and :84 call relative fetch('/api/notifications/settings') with `localStorage.getItem('__clerk_client_jwt')` — there is no Next API route or rewrite and that key isn't set by Clerk, so the page can't load or save real settings. Replace with notificationsApi + useAuth().getToken().

UX (RTL Hebrew, MUI, existing visual language of the page):
- Top: master push switch + browser permission state (reuse NotificationAsker logic) + 'pause notifications' snooze menu (1/2/4/8/24h, shows 'paused until HH:MM', resume button).
- Category matrix grouped Social (friend requests, messages, friend games, friend joins) / My games (reminders, updates & cancellations, invitations, organizer requests, group games) / Discovery (games in my city). Each row: title, one-line description, two compact switches 'Push' and 'In app' (messages: push only). Push switches disabled+dimmed when master push off.
- City games row expands: sports chips (from shared sports list), extra cities (Autocomplete with shared cityAliases), 'instant vs. daily summary' toggle + summary hour select.
- Quiet hours: enable switch + from/to time pickers, note 'in-app notifications still arrive'.
- Muted: list of muted people/groups/games with avatar, 'until' text and unmute.
- Auto-save: optimistic per change, debounced 400ms PATCH-style PUT with only changed keys, rollback + snackbar on error; remove the Save button. Loading skeleton unchanged (LoadingMotif).
- Keyboard/a11y: every switch has an aria-label.

title: web: mute entry points + new notification types in panel/routing
description:
- User profile (friends only): overflow/bell action 'Mute notifications from X' with durations (8h, 1 week, forever) / 'Unmute'. State from GET /mutes.
- Series page: 'Mute group notifications' toggle for subscribers.
- NotificationPanel: icons/labels for FRIEND_NEW_GAME, FRIEND_JOINED_GAME, NEW_SERIES_GAME; per-item kebab 'Turn off notifications like this' (sets that category's push+inApp off with undo snackbar) and, when data.actorId exists, 'Mute <name>'. Footer link to /settings/notifications.
- If page files turn out to be thin wrappers, put the UI in their client component instead and note the file swap in the PR (stays ≤3 files). Verify next_app/src/utils/notificationRoute.ts routes the new types (gameId-based -> /game/:id); if it needs a change that makes this 4 files, split into a separate step.

title: mobile: notification settings screen with full parity
description: Mobile today exposes only the master switch (settings/index.tsx:16-72). Add API methods mirroring step 9 (types from shared), a new expo-router screen settings/notifications.tsx with the same sections as web (master push incl. OS permission prompt / deep link to OS settings when denied — move the existing handleTogglePush logic here; snooze action sheet; category rows with Push / In-app switches; city filters with sport chips, cities, digest + hour; quiet hours via @react-native-community/datetimepicker if already a dependency, else a simple hour/minute picker; muted list with unmute). Optimistic auto-save with debounced partial PUT + revert and Alert on failure. settings/index.tsx: replace the inline switch with a row 'Notifications' -> router.push('/settings/notifications') showing a summary subtitle (On / Off / Paused until …). NativeWind classes consistent with the existing screen. All strings via t('notificationSettings.*') — keys added in step 13.

title: mobile: i18n strings for notification settings (he + en)
description: Add notificationSettings.* keys used by steps 12 and 14 (category titles/descriptions, channel labels, snooze options, quiet hours, digest, mute actions, errors) in both files with identical key sets. If the locales use the nested notifications/ directory instead of the flat json files, follow that convention.

title: mobile: mute entry points + new notification types in display
description: Same entry points as step 11: mute user from profile (friends), mute group from series screen, and resolveNotificationCopy/normalizeNotification + icon handling for FRIEND_NEW_GAME, FRIEND_JOINED_GAME, NEW_SERIES_GAME (route to the game). If the notifications list screen (mobile_app/app/notifications/index.tsx) needs a long-press 'turn off like this' action, add it as step 15 rather than exceeding 3 files.

title: quality gates + PR
description: next_app: `npm run build` green. mobile_app: typecheck + lint per PROMPT.md. server: run only the new/changed test files with PORT=3099 --runInBand (testing-jest.mdc), full suite only once before merge. Manual check in the web preview: settings page loads/saves against staging, toggles persist after reload. Open PR from feature/notification-preferences to main (never push main). PR body lists: migration, default changes (D1), the friends-only privacy fix, and the deferred item (city blast when friendsOnlyUntil expires).
